blurb: Pier 7 Resort Marina offers over 100 deep-water slips including wide stern-to catamaran slips, T-head slips, and monohull slips. They provide haul and launch services for catamarans up to 60 feet and boat lifts for power and sail boats. Amenities include private boat ramps, a private beach, waterfront apartment rentals, on-site laundry, private showers, and secure gated access.
